text:
tina: quick one — consuming @redwood/sdk from our pnpm monorepo into a Cloudflare Worker fails at runtime (module not found) and VSCode complains about missing types. Same package works if installed from npm.

leo: likely pnpm symlink + exports/types visibility. Share SDK package.json and your bundler config?

tina: package.json excerpt: {
 name:@redwood/sdk, main:dist/index.cjs.js, module:dist/index.esm.js, types:dist/index.d.ts, exports:{import:./dist/index.esm.js, require:./dist/index.cjs.js} 
}
We use esbuild in the deploy pipeline.

pat: esbuild + pnpm can treat linked packages as external if preserveSymlinks is true. Try setting preserveSymlinks:false so the bundler follows the workspace package files. Also check that dist actually contains index.d.ts after build.

tina: toggled preserveSymlinks:false — bundler now includes package code but editor still picks up root @types instead of the package d.ts.

leo: for TS in workspaces we added two things: (1) copy package.json into dist on build (postbuild cp package.json dist/package.json) so the bundler resolves the same manifest as published, (2) a typesVersions map in package.json to prefer dist types: "typesVersions":{"*":{"*":["dist/*"]}}. Ugly but fixes tsserver in monorepos.

tina: added dist/package.json + typesVersions — editor happy. But staging showed another issue: retries from the SDK lost Authorization header in worker runtime, leading to 401s on retry. Works in Node.

pat: worker Headers behave differently. If your retry clones Request via req.clone(), some runtimes drop certain headers. Make retries create a fresh Request and copy headers explicitly: new Request(req.url,{method:req.method,headers:new Headers(req.headers),body:req.body}). Also buffer JSON bodies so retries can re-send.

leo: and add an exports condition including types, e.g. "exports":{"import":{"default":"./dist/index.esm.js","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"},"require":{"default":"./dist/index.cjs.js","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}} — not every tool uses types in exports but it's helpful.

tina: thanks — PR incoming: will add dist/package.json in build, typesVersions, exports/types, example workspace for pnpm+esbuild, and fix retry cloning in SDK.

build-bot: CI preview: https://deploy.preview/monorepo-edge-fix (includes example app)

pat: TL;DR: pnpm symlinks + exports + types are the common failure mode; use dist/package.json + typesVersions, set preserveSymlinks:false for bundlers, and explicitly copy headers when retrying in edge runtimes.
